justification: Brief access decision implementation: the Intelligence Brief run route was fully open + anonymous with NO rate limit on a ~40s background job (cost/abuse hole), and the result had no lead-capture. Adds an IP rate-limit to the run route and an email-OPTIONAL post-result strip (never gates the result). Standard tier: one guard on an existing route + one reused UI component, no DB writes, no logic change to the brief itself.

pre_impl.existing_data: Run route /api/intelligence-brief triggers the Trigger.dev job from {address}; confirmed no prior rate-limit/auth/email gate. Reuses lib/rate-limit (satelliteRateLimiter, getClientIdentifier, checkRateLimit, createRateLimitHeaders) and components/reports/PostResultEmailStrip (posts to the existing /api/canibuildit/lead with interest_type).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The Brief stays open + anonymous per RULE 4 (early access, no signup/paywall) — the rate limit is an abuse/cost guard (12/hr/IP, generous for humans), NOT a paywall; the email strip is optional and post-result, NOT a gate.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: prior-art: no new components — reuses the shared rate-limiter and PostResultEmailStrip (same pattern as the satellite tools and the alerts opt-in).

functions: N/A — frontend route guard + reused UI component; no new Python functions.
values: N/A — address resolved as metadataEvent?.data.address ?? selectedAddress (selectedAddress is a non-null string state).
queries: N/A — no database access; run route hits Trigger.dev, strip posts to the existing lead API.

break_it.scenario: A script floods the Brief run route to burn compute
break_it.what_happens: after 12 runs/hour from one IP the route returns 429 with rate-limit headers; the job is not triggered
break_it.how: checkRateLimit(clientId, satelliteRateLimiter, 12, 3600000) guards the top of POST before any Trigger.dev call
break_it.repro: POST /api/intelligence-brief 13x from one IP within an hour -> 13th returns 429

break_it.scenario: The email strip accidentally blocks or gates the brief result
break_it.what_happens: it must not — the result renders fully; the strip is an optional add-on shown only when state==='complete'
break_it.how: PostResultEmailStrip is self-contained (own state, silent-fail fetch) and rendered after the result, never in front of it
break_it.repro: complete a brief, ignore the strip -> full brief visible and usable

break_it.scenario: Upstash Redis is unavailable when the rate-limit check runs
break_it.what_happens: checkRateLimit catches the Redis error and falls back to the in-memory limiter (per-instance) — the brief still runs, it does not hard-fail or block legitimate users
break_it.how: the shared checkRateLimit wraps limiter.limit() in try/catch and falls through to in-memory on error (verified in lib/rate-limit.ts)
break_it.repro: with Redis unreachable, POST /api/intelligence-brief still returns a runId via the in-memory fallback, not a 500

post_merge.secrets: No — reuses existing UPSTASH_REDIS + lead API; no new env vars.
post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — run a brief on prod: confirm it still runs anonymously (no signup), the result renders in full, an optional 'email me this brief' strip appears on completion, and rapid repeated runs from one IP eventually 429.
